demo.intro: An automatic tour of the main features.
demo.c.line: Start: scan the bus QR code, or choose the line.
demo.c.hello: Everything speaks when you touch it.
demo.c.check_no: Is this the right bus? Red: no, it has already passed.
demo.c.check_yes: Green: yes, this bus goes there.
demo.c.help: Orange: I need help to get out. It is shown and spoken to people around me.
demo.c.repeat: Communication: one touch to ask to repeat slowly. A seat is in Help.
demo.c.remind: I choose my stop to be reminded.
demo.c.calm: Green: all is well, I just wait.
demo.c.soon: Orange: get ready, my stop is next. The phone vibrates.
demo.c.now: Red: this is my stop, get off now. Strong vibration.
demo.c.lang: The language can be changed at any time.
demo.c.end: End of the demo. Scan a QR code to start.
demo.p.line: Start: scan the QR code in the bus.
demo.p.hello: 1 · Say hello: one touch, the phone speaks for me.
demo.p.langs: 1 · Say hello in any language: here, in Italian.
demo.p.verify: 2 · Verify the bus: red, wrong bus · green, right bus.
demo.p.buy: 3 · Buy a ticket: the request is shown and spoken.
demo.p.help: 4 · Need help? Urgent help, or ask to repeat slowly.
demo.p.notify: 5 · Notifications: I choose my stop, the phone warns me.
demo.p.end: Bus Buddy: take the bus on your own. Scan the QR code to try it.
